system.description:
The High Elven school of Myllnoris, where illusion is the purest art: creation through perception.

  • Sharpened Perception: Advantage on saves vs illusions, on top of Sharp Senses.
  • Art of Illusion: Advantage on performance checks that use illusion as the medium.
